snippet.title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a twisted dream world where fears come alive.

BOBO and the Chest of Nightmares is a 3D platformer filled with eerie atmospheres, surreal enemies, and with semi-open, handcrafted, highly replayable levels with strong verticality, secrets and themed mechanics inspired by classics like Crash, Spyro and MediEvil.

👉 Wishlist now on Steam and support indie development!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/456140/
